article.title: Anthropic announces closing of initial public offering, including full exercise of underwriters’ option to purchase additional shares, and closing of concurrent private placement
article.summary: Today Anthropic, PBC announced the closing of its initial public offering of an aggregate of 1,127,000,000 shares of its Class A common stock at a public offering price of $83.00 per share, including the full exercise by the underwriters of their option to purchase an additional 147,000,000 shares of Class A common stock from Anthropic at the initial public offering price.

radar.title: Nasdaq erases all 2026 gains as AI sell-off dampens Anthropic’s second day of trading
radar.summary: The Nasdaq lost trillions in value, with the AI startup’s IPO failing to buoy it as investors question huge sums being poured into AI buildout Who are Anthropic’s seven co-founders, now worth $180bn? As Anthropic’s stock dropped during its second day of trading, the wider stock market dipped with it. On Friday, the Nasdaq Composite erased all its gains for 2026 and closed down 5% from its value on 1 January. The Dow Jones Industrial Average and S&P 500 closed in correction territory.

radar.title: Anthropic estreia na bolsa: o que muda para as empresas que usam Claude
radar.summary: O maior IPO da história levantou US$ 81 bilhões. O prospecto mostra que o fornecedor de IA de milhares de empresas pode mudar preços, limites e contratos, e que o novo acionista quase não terá voto.

radar.title: Anthropic prices upsized IPO at $83, above the range; raises $81B in the largest IPO ever
radar.summary: Anthropic PBC, a developer of frontier AI models known for its Claude product line, raised $81.3 billion by offering 980 million shares (2% secondary) at $83, above the $70 to $78 range.
